title: Canonical finite coefficient site internal-Hom arrow
statement:
Let $\ell$ be prime, $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ a finite extension and $X$ a scheme. At every positive finite coefficient level $A_{E,n}$ of [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension], use the etale coefficient diagram of [def-sf-etale-finite-coefficient-hom-arrow] and the intrinsic pro-etale derived operations of [def-weil-derived-pullback-tensor-hom]. Define $
u_n^*$ by exact derived descent of the finite constant-ring module comparison $X_{\mathrm{proet}}	o X_{\mathrm{et}}$. Its canonical tensor comparison $\mu_n:
u_n^*(K\otimes^L_{A_{E,n}}M)\cong
u_n^*K\otimes^L_{A_{E,n}}
u_n^*M$ is characterized on flat K-flat representatives: the chain comparison sends each pure tensor of local etale sections to the same tensor of their images under the comparison and module-sheafification units, and its localization agrees with the intrinsic tensor-model comparison. Define $s^n_{K,M}:
u_n^*H_n(K,M)	o H_n(
u_n^*K,
u_n^*M)$ as the closed transpose of $\mu_n^{-1}$ followed by $
u_n^*$ of evaluation. The inverse-image functor and scalar beta are those of [def-sf-finite-coefficient-site-scalar-arrow]. The ordinary chain tensor comparison and exact-descent localization maps are those of [def-sf-finite-coefficient-site-chain-tensor].

proof.text: Use the resolving tensor presentation on the full subcategory of complexes with intrinsically K-flat inverse images. It gives fully faithful restriction on pairs, a source representative comparison, and the natural chain tensor comparison. The target intrinsic tensor-model comparison and exact-localization factorization are the existing specified ones.

Apply tensor comparison descent along fully faithful restriction. On each pair of representatives, cancel the invertible source and target localization comparisons to convert its equation into FiniteHomNuModelSquareAux. This equivalence of normalization equations transfers existence and uniqueness. Keep the specified source model map and chain comparison behind heterogeneous equality certificates through coefficient specialization. Existence uses the source and chain components; uniqueness identifies both certified witnesses with those components by eq_of_heq, so the square is precisely the original normalization.

proof_origin.note: Representative descent with explicit cancellation of localization comparison isomorphisms. The specified chain comparison is retained via a pointwise native isomorphism and a heterogeneous equality certificate, equivalent by substitution to the original square; uniqueness compares the native witnesses in the abstract categories.
